wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Lotan, son of Seir
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Lead, lines 104–106: Lotan son of Seir; says his sister Timna became Eliphaz’s concubine and bore Amalek; explicitly notes the text may refer to two people named Timna.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: The article directly discusses a Timna in Lotan’s family but preserves the possibility of two same-name figures. It is related only; it does not resolve whether the names in 1 Chronicles 1:36 and 1:39 identify one individual.
